summary: nested-lib postinstall beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: nested-lib@1.1.0 is a stub package whose only behavior is a reconnaissance beacon. The package.json postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, which collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), __dirname install path, process.cwd(), process.version, package name) and POSTs them as JSON to a hardcoded bare-IP plaintext HTTP endpoint at http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. index.js re-fires the same beacon on require() and otherwise exports a Proxy whose properties are no-ops, so the package provides no real functionality. The destination is not caller-configurable, uses plaintext HTTP to a bare IP, and bears no relation to any legitimate publisher infrastructure. The name and shape are consistent with a dependency-confusion / name-squatting recon payload designed to map internal build environments that resolve `nested-lib` from the public registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
